adaptation: papsg after paps-g SSR-007 (692f9716) and SSR-008 (b5760f73); wait result and queue extent corrections only. Support headers retain the selected base; rtx_lib.h adds only osRtxPostProcessTry. SSR-009 restart reload follows paps-g f5da5ea0. SSR-067 pool publication follows paps-g 093a51b6; other pool policy is unchanged. SSR-068 read-slot retirement and final backing-space accounting follow paps-g 8b5cbe9b/03fa6494; rtx_system adds queue-object dispatch and, after paps-g AUD-RES-024 (b483124c), a configured round-robin gate. SSR-069 follows paps-g d3b1f4d5 with necessary ISR-ring retirement 6e96f528; existing PostProcess overflow policy is retained. SSR-123 follows paps-g 8d211442: ISR message Put refuses failed deferred publication and frees its private block. SSR-124 follows paps-g f987e9d4: ISR pool Free admits a waiting allocator callback before releasing caller ownership. SSR-132 follows paps-g 3feed85e: retain destructive SysTick overflow observations until masked tick retirement, preserving IRQ mask and standard source selection. SSR-133 follows paps-g 6a244892: register the thread callback and reserve deferred publication before mutating ISR thread flags; full-ring refusal leaves waiter and flags unchanged. SSR-134 follows paps-g b1cd920c: publish an in-flight SVC Put, then reserve an ISR Get sender wakeup before detaching the message; refuse without mutation when the deferred ring is full. SSR-161 follows paps-g 5cc06c78: mutex priority restoration ignores waiting threads on non-inheriting owned mutexes.
